baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural construct at focus word 1 is followed by the coordinated names Abraham and Moses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The written-sheet branch makes the phrase a pair of provenance-bearing textual corpora. The proper names do more than identify a topic: they keep two lines of witness visible inside one compact attribution.

activation_trace.role: The written-sheet image supplies the textual medium, while the two following names organize that medium as attributed witness.

changed_reading.before: A bare label for old books associated with two figures.
changed_reading.after: Plural written witnesses whose authority remains indexed to two distinguishable prophetic provenances.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural noun at word 1 can retain the root's image of breadth even while denoting sheets.
baseline_models.mechanism: Flat spread and breadth foreground the sheet as an exposed surface. The phrase can therefore evoke teachings laid open side by side, with Abraham and Moses occupying a shared plane of disclosure without being collapsed into one source.

activation_trace.role: Flat breadth turns the named sheets from closed containers into surfaces on which distinct testimony can be openly spread.

changed_reading.before: Closed textual objects possessed by Abraham and Moses.
changed_reading.after: Two traditions laid out as broad, inspectable surfaces of disclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural sheets and the coordination of two names permit collection while preserving internal plurality.
baseline_models.mechanism: The codex branch pulls separate leaves toward an assembled archive, but the syntax does not require one physical volume. A live reading is a collectable cross-prophetic dossier whose unity consists in juxtaposition rather than source erasure.

activation_trace.role: Collected sheets supply an archival gathering mechanism, while the coordinated names preserve two components within the gathering.

changed_reading.before: Two unrelated references to earlier writings.
changed_reading.after: A gatherable constellation of leaves in which distinct Abrahamic and Mosaic provenances remain legible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root that denotes written sheets also carries a branch for error caused by confused written characters.
baseline_models.mechanism: Writing stabilizes a trace but introduces a medium-specific vulnerability: what is preserved can be misread. The two attributions keep provenance visible, yet the focus alone does not show whether parallel provenance corrects or compounds transmission error.

activation_trace.role: The written-sheet image supplies durable inscription as the condition for preservation.
Misreading from similar written forms supplies the graphic failure mode carried by that same preserving medium.

changed_reading.after: The named sheets preserve a trace while remaining exposed to specifically visual transmission error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant visible-mark branch activated by the repeated word for name makes the two proper names in the focus behave like legible marks on sheet-clusters. Attribution becomes part of the artifact's recognizability, not merely external ownership.

activation_trace.role: The written sheet provides the carrier on which an identifying provenance can be imagined as visibly registered.
A visible mark that makes something known turns the opening occurrence of name into an activator for marked provenance.
The repeated identifying-mark image near the close reinforces naming as a recognition mechanism before the final named sheets.

structural_cues: The word for name occurs at 87:1 and 87:15, and 87:19 ends by placing two proper names directly after the sheet noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated name occurrences and a non-dominant visible-identifying-mark branch; I supply the arrow from naming to marks of textual provenance. A live alternative is ordinary possessive attribution with no seal-like force.

changed_reading.before: The names merely state whose sheets these are.
changed_reading.after: Abraham and Moses function as visible provenance marks by which two bodies of sheets remain recognizable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created-leveled and measured-guided sequences recast the broad written surface as a formed interface: its arrangement, proportion, and directive use belong together. The sheets become patterned guidance rather than containers accidentally holding guidance.

activation_trace.role: Flat breadth supplies the surface whose formation and arrangement can carry directional force.

Measured planning supplies the ordered disposition by which textual elements can serve a designed end.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies the functional direction produced by the ordered surface.

structural_cues: The paired sequences created then leveled at 87:2 and measured then guided at 87:3 put formation before function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formation, leveling, measured planning, guidance, and sheet breadth; I transfer that process sequence onto textual form and infer that ordered presentation enables direction. The live alternative is that the sequence describes creation only and does not characterize the sheets.

changed_reading.before: Ancient documents that happen to contain directives.
changed_reading.after: Deliberately formed and proportioned guidance-surfaces whose textual shape participates in directing the reader.

context_deltas.mechanism: Emergence from concealment followed by floating dark residue creates a material cycle of disclosure and dispersal. Against that cycle, a written spread can be read as a surface that arrests selected traces before they are swept away as undifferentiated remainder.

activation_trace.role: The written sheet supplies a surface capable of retaining a selected trace through material change.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the first movement from latent content into exposure.
Floating debris borne by a torrent supplies the counter-image of traces dispersed without stable selection.
Dark coloration marks the terminal altered state against which inscription appears as arrested visibility.

structural_cues: The context moves from pasture brought out at 87:4 to dark floating residue at 87:5 before turning to recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, torrent-borne residue, darkening, and a writable sheet; I infer that inscription arrests a selected trace within flux. A live alternative is pure contrast: the vegetal cycle need not model textual preservation.

changed_reading.before: Old sheets surviving as inert objects.
changed_reading.after: Selective trace-surfaces that resist the cycle by which exposed material becomes dark, mobile residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation moves inscription into voice and memory; forgetting and the manifest-hidden pair make access reversible rather than automatic. The sheets become external memory traces that can recover what recitation makes present, while their own graphic form can also hide meaning through misreading.

A live alternative is that promised non-forgetting makes writing unnecessary and that manifest-hidden concerns knowledge rather than script.

changed_reading.before: Relics that merely report what Abraham and Moses once possessed.
changed_reading.after: Active interfaces among inscription, recitation, memory, disclosure, and the possibility of visually induced error.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease, reminder, benefit, and receptive awe turn textual survival into use. The named sheets are not valuable merely because they endure; they are carriers whose content becomes effective when opened into accessible recollection and answered by a responsive reader.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, a reminder-object, benefit, awe, and written sheets; I assign the sheets the carrier role linking those stages. The live alternative is an entirely oral reminder whose operation does not depend on the named sheets.

changed_reading.before: An archive whose importance lies in age and attribution.
changed_reading.after: A reusable reminder-medium whose accessibility, benefit, and reception determine whether preserved teaching becomes active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same remembered teaching can become a decision surface. One trajectory moves aside and encounters fire; the other purifies and becomes prayer. The split but overlapping fire-prayer branch inventories compress two opposed embodiments around one textual reminder.

Purity and rectification supply the contrary trajectory of receptive transformation.
Specified worship supplies the embodied endpoint of the receptive trajectory.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed sequences and cognate branch inventories joining fire and prayer; I infer that the named sheets carry the reminder at their common fork. changed_reading.before: The sheets are neutral records of propositions.
changed_reading.after: The sheets are a decision surface whose remembered content can be embodied as either distancing toward fire or purification toward prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts chosen nearness with delayed, beneficial endurance. Within the preference root's inventory, choosing and a remaining trace coexist; the named sheets become precisely such a surviving trace, present evidence that interrupts short-horizon preference.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies choice, a remaining-mark branch, nearness, laterness, beneficial good, endurance, and collected sheets; I infer that textual survival operates as evidence against near-term preference. strongest_changes: Recitation, forgetting, and the manifest-hidden pair turned written sheets into an oral-written memory circuit rather than inert relics.
Near choice versus later beneficial endurance turned the ancient sheets into a surviving countertrace against short-horizon preference.
The repeated noun in 87:18 made 87:19 a provenance expansion, while precedence and succession kept the named corpora live as a relay.
The response sequences allowed the same sheet-borne reminder to fork toward distancing and fire or purification and prayer.
summary.what_was_special: One focus root sustained coexisting images of written witness, open breadth, collected archive, graphic vulnerability, and shallow receptacle. Non-dominant mapped branches added names as visible provenance marks and former sheets as successive relay points without displacing the dominant readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not settle whether the plural denotes discrete leaves, gathered corpora, or a conceptual archive spanning both names.
The context supports but does not prove that the sheets themselves cause recollection, action, or the two response trajectories; an oral reminder remains live.
The visible-mark, succession, basin, graphic-error, and return-to-outcome activations should remain explicitly exploratory because their mechanisms are branch-distant or analogical.
